The '''2018 Naboo Regionals''' were the United Kingdom regional championship, held on 2 June 2018 in Liverpool. Ten players played eight Swiss games with no final confrontation. [[Paul McPherson]] won with a 7–1 record; [[Justin Branch]] was second.<ref name="nab">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=67818 UK (Naboo) Regional - Staurday 2nd June 2018 - Liverpool], forum.starwarsccg.org (6 December 2017 – 3 June 2018). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105004248/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t67818.html Internet Archive]</ref>

The standings were posted by the forum user Darth Eweuge, who named Paul (listed as "Paul McWelsh") the 2018 Naboo Regional Champion. Justin Branch also won the pre-regional bowling night.<ref name="nab" />
